current_point.claim: 在分布式图神经网络训练中，提出了基于边分割的图流划分算法，用于将大规模图数据划分为多个子图并分配给工作者节点，有效解决了图数据不规则性导致的分布式训练难点，提升了训练效率。
current_point.claim_en: In distributed graph neural network training, a graph flow partition algorithm based on edge segmentation is proposed to partition large-scale graph data into multiple subgraphs and assign them to worker nodes, effectively addressing the difficulties caused by irregularity of graph data in distributed training and improving training efficiency.
technical_features: 基于边分割的图流划分算法将原图划分为子图，适用于图流数据场景
划分后的子图分配给各工作节点，实现并行处理
该算法能够适应动态图流数据的变化，提高分布式训练的扩展性
technical_features_en: A graph flow partition algorithm based on edge segmentation partitions the original graph into subgraphs, suitable for graph streaming data scenarios
The partitioned subgraphs are assigned to worker nodes for parallel processing
The algorithm adapts to changes in dynamic graph streaming data, improving scalability of distributed training
